proof: Evaluating a linear relation on the selected X vectors forces each distinct-owner coefficient to vanish. Therefore rank(U union O)=rank(U)+|O| when O chooses at most one vector per owner. The exact weighted bound is sum positive maxima per owner plus a maximum-weight independent set of U. Ordinary binary-matroid greedy suffices.
contraction: Forced unowned anchors are contracted before optimizing other unowned anchors; forced owned anchors occupy their owner bins and do not change rank on the unowned subspace.
cost: For each small S branch, inspect45 pair profiles, choose each owner maximum, and greedily reduce at most45 unowned vectors. No2^45 enumeration or new software API is needed.
scope: Necessary partial-permutation and linear-independence support bound only; no source completion.
